# Quedate Jugando

<!-- Generated from manifest.json by scripts/build.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Montevideo shop selling board games, card games, puzzles, outdoor games and stationery such as agendas and notebooks, and publishing a few games of its own. Ships to the whole country and offers free pickup at its Montevideo store.
